lead: Test of 0.8.37 (CI test build 41288474375). risk.py: class C on all three systems, so from the core list only the automated runs (hil: cold start, reopen, export). The round's own items: your own ROM banks (#22, tried with the test switch rom-user.on, because our Virus has only factory ROMs), Up/Down in the browser (#23) and the browser bank fix (E383). Linux was checked with dev builds during the round; Windows and the Mac have seen nothing of this round yet. Mark each item, add a note where something looks different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat.
rules: Order: Linux first (the Virus is on this PC), then the Windows VM, then the Mac. Close the DAW before the Virus moves.
Never power-cycle the Virus while it is attached to the VM; switch it off and on only while it is on Linux.
Use a disposable project. The test switch only makes the plug-in read a ROM bank from the Virus; it writes nothing to the Virus. Claude sets it before a block and removes it afterwards.

sections.title: Linux
sections.where: REAPER, Virus on this PC, CI build 0.8.37 (installed with install.sh)
prep: Claude installs the CI build, runs hil.sh (cold start, reopen, export, broker killed while playing) and sets the test switch to ROM C.

items.title: Own ROM bank read from the Virus (#22, test switch ROM C)
steps: Start REAPER, open the plug-in. Wait for 'Synchronizing ROM C 1 / 128 ... 128 / 128' (about 2 minutes); play a few notes meanwhile.
Browser: open ROM C. On the Virus, step through a few ROM C patches.
Close REAPER and open it again.
items.expect: Notes play and the read pauses for them; ROM C shows its names; the Virus' own steps load the right sound; after the restart no sync page.

items.title: Up/Down in the browser and the bank fix
steps: Click a patch in the browser, press Down and Up a few times, then hold Down for two seconds. Click a knob, press Down.
Choose a ROM A patch in the browser, then Program +/- on the Virus a few times.
items.expect: Each press loads the next/previous patch; holding runs through the list and loads where it stops; after the knob click the browser does not react. The Virus' steps stay in ROM A (no jump to a RAM patch).

sections.title: Windows 11 (VM)
sections.where: win11 VM, Ableton Live 11, CI build 0.8.37 (installed silently by Claude)
prep: Claude installs the build in the VM, attaches the Virus, copies the hil-windows kit and sets the test switch to ROM C (%LOCALAPPDATA%\virus-ti-native\rom-user.on).

items.title: hil-win on the new build
steps: Run hil-win.cmd (about 5 minutes); Claude grades the result folder on Linux.
items.expect: Cold start, reopen and export pass (drift in the VM is not judged, E334).

items.title: Own ROM bank read from the Virus (#22, test switch ROM C)
steps: Open the plug-in in Live. Wait for 'Synchronizing ROM C ... / 128' (about 2 minutes); play a few notes meanwhile.
Browser: open ROM C; step through a few ROM C patches on the Virus. Close Live and open the project again.
items.expect: ROM C shows its names, the Virus' steps load the right sound, no sync page after reopening.

items.title: Up/Down in the browser and the bank fix in Live
steps: Click a patch in the browser, press Down/Up, hold Down. (If Live takes the arrow keys, note it.)
Choose a ROM A patch in the browser, then Program +/- on the Virus.
items.expect: As on Linux: steps load, holding loads where it stops, the Virus' steps stay in ROM A.

sections.title: macOS
sections.where: MacBook Air M3, Ableton Live 12, CI build 0.8.37 (the user installs the package; Claude pushes it)
prep: Claude pushes the package with INSTALL-COMMAND.txt and 'Install test build.command', the hil-mac kit, and sets the test switch to ROM C (~/Library/Application Support/virus-ti-native/rom-user.on).

items.title: hil-mac on the new build
steps: Double-click hil/hil-mac.command (about 5 minutes); Claude grades the results.
items.expect: Cold start, reopen and export pass.

items.title: Own ROM bank read from the Virus (#22, test switch ROM C)
steps: Open the plug-in in Live (VST3). Wait for 'Synchronizing ROM C ... / 128'; play a few notes meanwhile.
Browser: open ROM C; step through a few ROM C patches on the Virus. Close Live and open the project again.
items.expect: ROM C shows its names, the Virus' steps load the right sound, no sync page after reopening.

items.title: Up/Down in the browser and the bank fix in Live
steps: Click a patch in the browser, press Down/Up, hold Down.
Choose a ROM A patch in the browser, then Program +/- on the Virus.
